query:
SELECT max(substring(name FROM char_length($2) + 1)::bigint) AS "n"
           FROM (SELECT name FROM databases WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND name ~ ('^' || $2 || '[0-9]+$')
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT name FROM db_users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND name ~ ('^' || $2 || '[0-9]+$')) x
